title: Portalinmobiliario Property Scraper
description: Scrape property data from portalinmobiliario.com by place, URL, or specific listing URLs.

scrapeMode.title: Scrape mode
scrapeMode.description: overview (search cards only) or detail (opens each listing).

searchMode.title: Search by
searchMode.description: Build URL by place, use a full search URL, or provide listing URLs.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Optional condition path segment in byPlace mode.

modality.title: Modalidad
modality.description: Filtro general: usadas, nuevas o proyectos (byPlace).

publishedSince.title: Publicado desde
publishedSince.description: any = sin filtro. today = usa el filtro nativo del sitio (_PublishedToday_YES). last_week = se aplica como post-filtro leyendo el badge real de la página de detalle ('Publicado hoy/esta semana/hace X'); el sitio no tiene un facet de 'última semana', así que en scrapeMode=overview no se puede verificar y se deja pasar. Por defecto: última semana.

priceCurrency.title: Moneda del precio
priceCurrency.description: Moneda de minPrice/maxPrice. Si el aviso viene en la otra (UF vs CLP), se convierte con la UF del día.

minPrice.title: Precio mínimo
minPrice.description: Precio mínimo en priceCurrency (UF o CLP). Si el aviso está en la otra moneda, se convierte antes de comparar.

maxPrice.title: Precio máximo
maxPrice.description: Precio máximo en priceCurrency (UF o CLP). Si el aviso está en la otra moneda, se convierte antes de comparar.

minBedrooms.title: Dormitorios mínimo
minBedrooms.description: Cantidad mínima de dormitorios (acepta string, número o texto null).

maxBedrooms.title: Dormitorios máximo
maxBedrooms.description: Cantidad máxima de dormitorios (acepta string, número o texto null).

minBathrooms.title: Baños mínimo
minBathrooms.description: Cantidad mínima de baños (acepta string, número o texto null).

maxBathrooms.title: Baños máximo
maxBathrooms.description: Cantidad máxima de baños (acepta string, número o texto null).

minParking.title: Estacionamientos mínimo
minParking.description: Cantidad mínima de estacionamientos (acepta string, número o texto null).

maxParking.title: Estacionamientos máximo
maxParking.description: Cantidad máxima de estacionamientos (acepta string, número o texto null).

listingUrls.title: Listing URLs
listingUrls.description: Used when searchMode=byListingUrl. Accepts a JSON array string, comma-separated URLs, or newline-separated URLs.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of items to output (acepta string o número).

maxPages.title: Max search pages
maxPages.description: Only used for byPlace and bySearchUrl (acepta string o número).

withParking.title: With parking (alias)
withParking.description: Alias compatible con entrepropiedades-actor. Si true, exige estacionamiento.

includeDetails.title: Include details (alias)
includeDetails.description: Alias compatible con entrepropiedades-actor. true=detail, false=overview cuando scrapeMode no venga.

requireContactData.title: Require contact data
requireContactData.description: If true, only returns properties with a visible phone or contact link. Off by default: WhatsApp reveal is often blocked by recaptcha/daily limits, so requiring it can return zero results.

resolveContactViaBrowser.title: Resolve WhatsApp via browser
resolveContactViaBrowser.description: Only for scrapeMode=detail + searchMode=byListingUrl. Uses browser click flow to capture /contact-info/whatsapp response.

browserConcurrency.title: Browser concurrency
browserConcurrency.description: Only when resolveContactViaBrowser=true. Recommended 1-2. Higher values increase CPU usage.

maxBrowserListings.title: Max browser listings to scan
maxBrowserListings.description: Only when resolveContactViaBrowser=true. Limits how many listingUrls are opened in browser.

maxConsecutiveContactFailures.title: Max consecutive contact failures before stopping
maxConsecutiveContactFailures.description: Only when resolveContactViaBrowser=true. Stops the browser crawler early after this many consecutive listings without a direct contact, to avoid wasting time when most listings are blocked (e.g. by recaptcha). Default 6.

contactsCsvPath.title: Broker contacts CSV path
contactsCsvPath.description: Optional CSV file path used to enrich contact phones by matching seller/corredora names. Defaults to 'Contacto de Corredoras - Hoja 1.csv'.

trustPortalPriceRange.title: Trust portal-side price range filter
trustPortalPriceRange.description: If true (default) and byPlace already has PriceRange_*, mixed UF/CLP cards are converted (or trusted if the UF rate is unavailable) instead of being discarded.
